title: S1b: skill telemetry in shadow: which skills each worker was exposed to and invoked, skill tokens per run, skill_selection decision rows, skill columns in the economy scorecard; exposure unchanged
spec:
Program brief .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md P0 telemetry, P29, P30 (P37 stage 1). Depends on S1a (orchestrator/skills_registry.py: SkillRecord, sync, registry records with roles/est tokens). Facts: Claude workers run in worktrees that carry .claude/skills (11 symlinked skills; all descriptions are in context, bodies load on Skill-tool invocation); Codex executors load implement-spec via AGENTS.md and their final message says "Skill used: <name>" when they did; bus.log_run rows carry packet_meta and a context object (P1 telemetry); decision_log.KINDS has the context-program kinds; context_scorecard builds per role/goal/task_class rows and `scorecard --economy` joins sources.
Do:
1. Exposure: in spawn.run_worker (and the Claude execute fallback) compute `skills_exposed` = registry records whose roles include the worker's role or "*" and whose state is active (today: all 11 for Claude roles; implement-spec for codex_execute via AGENTS.md), with skill_tokens_l0 = sum est_tokens_l0; write them into the task's packet_meta ("skills_exposed": ids, "skill_tokens_l0") so bus.log_run carries them into the run context (add the keys to bus.py's copied list). Codex dispatch (daemon/executor.start) records ["executor/implement-spec"] and its l0 tokens the same way.
2. Usage: after a worker finishes, detect invoked skills: for Claude workers parse the run transcript (the path recorded for the run; the executor verifies the exact JSON shape of a Skill tool_use in .orchestrator/runs transcripts and documents it) for tool_use names "Skill" with input.skill or the skill name; for Codex parse the result summary for "Skill used: <name>" lines. Record `skills_used` (ids), `skill_tokens_l2` (sum est_tokens_l2 of used skills) in the run row's context and in the task pipeline ("skills_used").
3. decision_log: add kind "skill_selection" to KINDS (and CONTEXT_KINDS docstring mapping); record one row per worker spawn: candidates = all registry ids for the role, hard_constraints = ["static exposure (stage 1)"], deterministic = {"role", "task_class", "exposed": ids, "skill_tokens_l0"}, selected = exposed ids, reason = "stage1 static", mode = "shadow"; and after completion decision_log.outcome(task, "skill_selection", skills_used=..., skill_tokens_l2=...).
4. Scorecard (P30 first metrics): orchestrator/skill_scorecard.py (new): from run rows: per role and per skill id: exposures, uses, use_rate, skill_tokens_l0 avg, skill_tokens_l2 avg, skill_overhead_ratio = (skill_tokens_l0 + skill_tokens_l2) / input tokens of the run (when input tokens known), plus per accepted task (lineage merged) skill_tokens_per_accepted_task. `orchestrator scorecard --skills` prints it; `scorecard --economy` gains a skills block.
5. docs/skill-intelligence/02-telemetry.md (≤60 lines): fields, where they live, how usage is detected for each worker kind, limits (Claude Code loads descriptions itself; l0 tokens are an estimate), revert path (nothing to revert: pure logging; remove the keys).
Constraints: no change to prompts, allowlists, symlinks or which skills a worker sees; a telemetry failure never breaks a spawn (try/except + one notify line). Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally.
Tests (unittest): tests/test_spawn.py::test_run_worker_records_skills_exposed_and_l0_tokens, ::test_skill_usage_parsed_from_claude_transcript, ::test_skill_usage_parsed_from_codex_summary; tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_carries_skill_keys; tests/test_decision_log.py::test_skill_selection_kind_records_and_outcome; tests/test_skill_scorecard.py::test_use_rate_and_overhead_ratio_per_skill, ::test_skill_tokens_per_accepted_task.
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.
acceptance: docs/skill-intelligence/02-telemetry.md exists; `uv run orchestrator scorecard --skills` runs; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
